relationship: school teacher (elder) — formal, respectful register; Hindi greeting, quote and closing, English body

quote.text: गुरु गोविंद दोऊ खड़े, काके लागूं पाय। बलिहारी गुरु आपनो, गोविंद दियो बताय॥
quote.translation: Teacher and God both stand before me. Whose feet do I touch first? The teacher's, for it was the teacher who showed me the way.

body: In Class 9, when I couldn't make sense of my first computer program, you stayed back after school three days a week to sit beside me until it finally ran.
I write software for a living today, and I still hear your voice when I'm stuck: 'Read the error slowly, beta. It's trying to help you.'
You gave your time without ever being asked, and you made a nervous boy believe he could learn anything.
May this Diwali fill your home with light, as you filled so many of our lives with it.

fun_fact.text: Fun fact: "Diwali" comes from the Sanskrit dīpāvali, "a row of lights". You lit one of mine.
fun_fact.source: Standard dictionaries: Diwali, from Sanskrit dīpāvali
